basics.name: Jonathan E. Hunter MChem Ph. D.
basics.label: Life Sciences Researcher | Analytical Chemist | Data Scientist | Chemical Informatician
basics.summary: Driven to deliver impactful scientific insights through elegant solutions with a deep passion for life-long learning. Experienced in international, cross-disciplinary research with significant contributions in analytical chemistry and data science.

work.name: LGC
work.description: Led development of proprietary analytical methods for occupational drug testing utilising LC-MS and GC-MS approaches in a regulated laboratory environment. Also undertook contract research, implemented novel technologies and provided supervision, technical training and mentoring.
work.summary: Developed methods for phytocannabinoid determination and contributed key technical expertise to a large commercial research study on epicatechin metabolism.
highlights: Developed proprietary analytical methods using LC-MS and GC-MS

work.name: Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution
work.description: Conducted research on microscale chemical and physical processes in marine organic matter degradation. Developed a novel nanoLC-MS methodology and collaborated with international partners.
work.summary: Implemented high-sensitivity nanoLC-MS techniques and delivered high impact publications including co-lead authorship in Science.
highlights: Developed novel nanoLC-MS methodology for high-sensitivity analysis
Collaborated with partner laboratories in Zurich and Calgary
Delivered impactful publications in Science and Environmental Science & Technology

work.name: University of Southampton, Faculty of Medicine
work.description: Characterized reactive oxygen and nitrogen modified lipids.
work.summary: Conducted research on lipid modifications related to oxidative stress.
